extracted.intended_audience: novelists and fiction writers seeking a structural beat sheet for plotting a novel
extracted.subtask_description: A 15-beat structural template (Save the Cat! for novels) that maps key plot beats and their approximate story-percent placement to guide plotting, pacing, and character transformation across three acts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opening Image
rubrics_metrics.description: 0–1% — Visual snapshot of hero's current world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theme Stated
rubrics_metrics.description: 5% — A character hints at the life lesson protagonist must learn.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setup
rubrics_metrics.description: 1–10% — Hero's flawed status quo, supporting characters, primary goal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Catalyst
rubrics_metrics.description: 10% — Life-changing event that prevents return to old life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debate
rubrics_metrics.description: 10–20% — Hero wrestles with whether to accept the call.

rubrics_metrics.name: Break Into 2
rubrics_metrics.description: 20% — Hero accepts change; enters new world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Midpoint
rubrics_metrics.description: 50% — False victory or false defeat; stakes escalate.

rubrics_metrics.name: All Is Lost
rubrics_metrics.description: 75% — Lowest point; "death of the old hero."

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Image
rubrics_metrics.description: 99–100% — Mirror of opening; hero's transformed life.
